changelog:
- Top-line Quick Refresh Button: One-tap reload button integrated on the quick navigation bar directly beside Back, Forward, and Home.
- Zero-Blank-Screen YouTube Ad Skipper: Completely resolved the 5-10 second blank screen stall on YouTube video ads by accelerating playback to 16x and seeking directly to duration without hiding the player container.
- Authentic Multi-Colored Search Engine Logos: Cleared purple silhouette tint filter from address bar so Google, DuckDuckGo, Brave, Ecosia, and Startpage display in their full authentic brand colors.
- Seamless Ghost Mode Toggle: Instant ON/OFF toggle right on the homepage hero bar with live status indicators and zero accidental search redirects.
- Clean 3-Dot Menu Hierarchy: Streamlined daily tools at the top with long-term configurations and browser info routed to dedicated Settings and About pages.
